blurb: Klier Sky Aviation offers helicopter tours over San Diego County, including coastal, back country, bay, and custom tours. They are a Naval Special Warfare Combat Veteran owned, FAA approved company using Robinson R44 helicopters. Tours provide breathtaking views and memorable experiences of San Diego and Southern California landmarks.
